name: Tooltip
summary: A short description on hover and focus that satisfies all three parts of SC 1.4.13 — dismissible, hoverable, persistent — with the toggletip that touch users can actually reach beside it.
demoNote: Press Esc with the pointer still on a trigger, then move the pointer from a trigger onto its bubble — those two are what most tooltips fail. Example 3 is the native title attribute, kept as a comparison; example 4 is the version that works on a phone.

contract.useWhen: A description on hover and focus, plus the toggletip for touch.
keyboard: dismisses, and the dismissal is remembered until focus or the pointer moves
failureModes: hover only, which fails all three of dismissible, hoverable and persistent (SC 1.4.13)
pointer-events:none on the bubble, the usual hoverable failure
aria-describedby toggled with visibility, taking the text from the people who rely on it
a tap leaving a bubble stuck open — filter on pointerType === 'touch'
interactive content inside the bubble, which nothing can reach
essential information only in a tooltip, which touch users often cannot summon
api: AC.createTooltip(root, options) -> { show, hide, isOpen, trigger, tip, destroy }
